candidates.statement: Inventory calls to Redis are timing out (10 redis_operation_timeout errors, status 504), driving inventory p95 to 1080ms and 27 dependency timeouts; gateway's call to inventory errors at 945ms, propagating checkout latency/errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry not provided; timeout cause (load, network, saturation) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Inventory logs show repeated Redis operation timeouts with 504s, matching inventory's elevated p95 and dependency timeouts; gateway traces show the downstream inventory call erroring. Order and gateway metrics remain healthy, localizing the fault to inventory's Redis dependency. Deployment record alone does not establish causation.
